create.name: Tom Condon
create.bio:
Tom Condon is an Enneagram teacher and coach who has worked with the nine-type personality map since 1980 and with Ericksonian hypnosis and neuro-linguistic programming since the late 1970s. His approach, which he calls the Dynamic Enneagram, treats a person's type less as a label than as a set of habits and inner trances that can be noticed and loosened, and he brings in practical change methods from NLP, hypnosis and brief therapy, adapted to the patterns of each type. The International Enneagram Association has recognised him with its Accredited with Honor status.

He has led several hundred workshops across North America, Europe and Asia and has produced dozens of books, recordings and videos, among them The Dynamic Enneagram, released chapter by chapter as an ebook, and The Enneagram Movie & Video Guide, which uses films to illustrate the types. He has often taught alongside Russ Hudson, and he offers 75-minute coaching sessions by phone or video for people who want to use the Enneagram for personal and spiritual growth. His long-running company, The Changeworks, is based in Bend, Oregon.

courses.title: Enneagram Coaching with Tom Condon
courses.description: Private 75-minute sessions by phone or video that combine the Enneagram with NLP and other change methods, with handouts and practices to take away. Available singly or as a block of four ($450 USD).

courses.title: The Dynamic Enneagram (ebook)
courses.description: Tom Condon's practical guide to using the Enneagram for change, published as an ebook in instalments: five foundation chapters plus a chapter for each type. Sold as a whole or chapter by chapter.

courses.title: Dynamic Enneagram Videos
courses.description: Downloadable videos edited from his live Enneagram workshops, showing his teaching and his work with people of each type.
